scientific_integrity: The finite checks verify consistency, not the infinite limit. A proof via orthogonal decomposition and Hilbert--Schmidt convergence is supplied. Mathematical and bibliographic independent audits have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete rooted regular trees only; fixed branching integer and fixed singular rank as the height increases; no uniformity in growing rank or nonregular trees.
